title: IV1 Strong Security Bounds Beyond gwc
summary: The stronger IV1 security bound is proved with gwc, while the proof is weaker for general 2-wise independent hashes; whether other instantiations can match it remains open.

formal_statement.body: The strong IV1 security bound uses a hash function $H$ instantiated with $\mathsf{gwc}$ and yields $O(r^2\lVert\ell\rVert(\lVert\sigma\rVert + q + r)^2/2^{2n})$. The unresolved task is to determine whether other hash-function instantiations, especially general 2-wise independent ones, can achieve a comparable bound; for a general 2-wise independent hash function, the stated proof approach guarantees only $O(\lVert\ell\rVert(\lVert\sigma\rVert + q)/2^n)$, which imposes a stricter limit on $\lVert\ell\rVert$ under the same query limit.

scope.domain: Security analysis of IV1 deterministic authenticated encryption under gwc and alternative hash-function instantiations.
assumptions: For the highlighted general case, the alternative hash function is 2-wise independent.
The limitations are compared under the same query limit.
parameters: H: hash function fixed to gwc in the known stronger bound and varied in the open task
r: parameter appearing in the gwc-instantiated bound
ℓ: parameter whose allowable limit becomes stricter under the general proof bound
σ and q: parameters shared by both compared bounds
n: exponent parameter governing the powers-of-two denominators
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether other hash-function instantiations, especially general 2-wise independent ones, can attain a security bound comparable to the gwc-instantiated IV1 bound.

citations.label: Towards Optimally Secure Deterministic Authenticated Encryption Schemes

progress.summary: The source proves the stronger IV1 bound using gwc and observes that its approach gives only a weaker guarantee for a general 2-wise independent hash function. Comparable bounds from other hash instantiations remain unresolved.
citation_labels: Yu Long Chen et al., Towards Optimally Secure Deterministic Authenticated Encryption Schemes
